resources.string: The map app used on the dashboard map screen; takes effect when selected.
Please read this in full before first use. After accepting, you can reread it at the bottom of the main screen.

Supersampling renders at 1.5× resolution and scales back down, which shrinks the empty band above portrait apps; turn it off for landscape apps (sharper and smoother). Auto = on when a portrait app is detected.

The video stream renders the virtual display and encoded picture at a percentage of the head-unit resolution (the logical layout is unchanged), and caps the resolution requested from CarWith; lower it on low-end receivers to reduce decoding load. Resolution changes apply on the next connection; frame rate is the streaming refresh rate and applies immediately (CarWith\'s actual encode rate is set in CarWith).

Request CarWith to encode at most a 1280-pixel long side (about 720p) and cap the compositor at 30fps; applies on the next connection. CarWith 4.0.23 may keep its own resolution; if the request is ignored, set 1280x720 under CarWith Settings → Connection info → Resolution.

When on, native CarWith sound is mixed on the phone and played over the car\'s Bluetooth A2DP; CarPlay carries video only. The car must keep A2DP connected during CarPlay; otherwise the app falls back to AirPlay. Applies on the next connection, and sound must be enabled in the connect dialog.

When on, mcarplay attaches to an already-running CarWith session without opening CarWith. Start the CarWith connection first and keep it in the background; if its listeners are not running, this connection fails with a message instead of opening CarWith. Applies on the next connection.

Lower the AirPlay audio buffer floor from 250ms to 100ms to cut end-to-end latency; audio may underrun or drop when Wi-Fi jitter is high. Applies on the next connection; not used with car Bluetooth output.
Turn the panel off while connected

After connecting, the phone panel is physically powered off (the system stays awake and the virtual display keeps rendering); when off, only dimming is used. Press the power button twice to restore the screen.
Starts a connection when the app opens or the selected car reconnects over Bluetooth. Select a target car first, and allow "Display over other apps" so the app can be opened in the background.

When the car reconnects its Bluetooth, open the app and connect automatically (system ACL only; no scanning or polling). Select a target car first; allow "Display over other apps" and disable battery limits, or the system may silently block the launch.

For key calibration: when on, each HID report is logged as a HID-RAW line (uuid + hex bytes) so you can match steering-wheel/knob presses to key mappings. Keep it off normally to avoid flooding the log.
Fallback: try unencrypted after pairing fails

Off by default. When pairing fails (except 403) but the receiver is reachable, try one unencrypted session. Turn on only if the receiver always stalls at pairing and you know it supports only unencrypted sessions; applies on the next connection.
Fallback: try audio when no format is declared

Off by default. When the receiver declares no usable media audio format, still try the default PCM 48k. Turn on only if the car can play sound but mcarplay always sends video only; this may cause silence or a disconnect. Applies on the next connection.

While a navigation or voice prompt plays, music is lowered to this level and fades back afterwards. Drag right to lower it more; far left means no lowering. Default -15 dB. Changes apply immediately while connected.
Changes apply immediately while connected; the status card shows actual/target frame rate
Raise it if touch lags while the frame rate is normal (events piling up); applies as you drag

When on, portrait apps render full-screen landscape on the car display. The switch is saved and applies on the next connection; the system override lasts only for the session and is undone automatically afterwards, so apps return to their normal orientation. Note: some text may get larger or smaller. Toggling restarts the app right away (a running app loses unsaved screen state).
Paired devices can be selected directly; tapping an unpaired device starts system Bluetooth pairing
No paired devices yet; scan below and tap one to pair
Adjust the dimming opacity and blur of the dock wallpaper; applies as you drag.
Scales the whole dock (icons, clock, text) from 50% to 100%; applies on the next connection
